chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who applies al-nurah (a hair removal paste), so he makes for himself a mixture of fine flour with oil to paste with it, so he wipes with it after the al-nurah to remove its smell from himself. He (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem.

key_terms.النُّورَةِ: Al-nurah: A paste used for hair removal, typically made from flour and other ingredients.
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: La ba'sa: There is no problem; it is permissible.
key_terms.لِيَقْطَعَ رِيحَهَا: Liyaqta'a reehaha: To cut off or remove its smell/odor.
key_terms.يَلُتُّ: Yaluttu: To paste or apply a thick substance.

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to use flour and oil to remove the smell of hair removal paste after bathing?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on the bathhouse, this hadith clarifies the permissibility of using a flour-and-oil paste to neutralize the odor of *al-nurah* (hair removal paste) after bathing. Imam al-Sadiq’s ruling of 'no objection' highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of ease (*yusr*) in personal hygiene, distinguishing between ritual impurity (*najāsah*) and mere unpleasant smell (*riḥ*), thereby affirming that removing odor does not require complex purification rituals.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the man who waxes with Al-Noura, so he makes a container for himself of the flour with the oil to paste with it, so he touches with it upon himself after Al-Noura in order to cut-off its smell from himself’. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn ‘Ushaym from Sufayman af-Ja‘fariy who has said the foifowing: “He (the Imam) has said, ‘If one wants to gain weight he should use a bathhouse one day and the day after the next day but if one is heavy and wants to lose weight he should use a bathhouse every day.”’
